summary_en: This study tests LNTH-2403, a monoclonal antibody that targets LRRC15 and is labeled with lutetium-177, in people with relapsed or refractory osteosarcoma. In the dose-finding phase, the drug is given once every 8 weeks, and other schedules may be explored based on dosimetry, pharmacokinetic, safety, and tolerability data; the route of administration is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body, radiation dose, and early signs of anti-cancer activity.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba LNTH-2403, un anticuerpo monoclonal dirigido a LRRC15 y marcado con lutecio-177, en personas con osteosarcoma recidivante o refractario. En la fase de búsqueda de dosis, el medicamento se administra una vez cada 8 semanas, y podrían explorarse otros esquemas según los datos de dosimetría, farmacocinética, seguridad y tolerancia; la vía de administración no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerancia, cómo se mueve el medicamento en el cuerpo, la dosis de radiación y las primeras señales de actividad contra el cáncer.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory osteosarcoma confirmed by tumor pathology.
Measurable or evaluable disease, or bone-only disease that is FDG-PET avid.
Age 12 or older in later cohorts; 18 or older for the first Phase 1 cohort.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 or Lansky score of 50 or more, and weight of 30 kg or more.
Disease progression after at least one course of chemotherapy.
not_for: Known allergy or intolerance to LNTH-2403 or its excipients.
Concurrent anti-cancer treatment, including localized radiation therapy.
Participation in another interventional study of an investigational agent.
Known active infection or known HIV positive status.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or major surgery within 28 days of the first dose.
